11033-the-angel-over-the-right-shoulder-.title: Beginning Of A New Year.
11033-the-angel-over-the-right-shoulder-.creator: Unknown
11033-the-angel-over-the-right-shoulder-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. James had chosen the two hours before dinner as being, on the whole, the most convenient and the least liable to interruption. They dined at one o'clock. She wished to finish her morning work, get dressed for the day, and enter her room at eleven.

arxiv-1911-07083.title: Non-trivial higher Massey products in moment-angle complexes
arxiv-1911-07083.creator: Jelena Grbić, Abigail Linton
arxiv-1911-07083.description: Abstract . As part of various obstruction theories, non-trivial Massey products have been studied in symplectic and complex geometry, commutative algebra and topology for a long time. We introduce a general approach to constructing non-trivial Massey products in the cohomology of moment-angle complexes, using homotopy theoretical and combinatorial methods.

arxiv-2101-05627.title: Superconducting critical temperature in the extended diffusive SYK model
arxiv-2101-05627.creator: F.Salvati, A.Tagliacozzo 1,2,3
arxiv-2101-05627.description: Abstract Models for strongly interacting fermions in disordered clusters forming an array, with electron hopping between sites, reproduce the linear dependence on temperature of the resistivity, typical of the strange metal phase of High Temperature Superconducting materials (Extended Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) models).

arxiv-2107-04846.title: Propagation-aware Social Recommendation by Transfer Learning
arxiv-2107-04846.creator: Haodong Chang, Yabo Chu
arxiv-2107-04846.description: Abstract Social-aware recommendation approaches have been recognized as an effective way to solve the data sparsity issue of traditional recommender systems. The assumption behind is that the knowledge in social user-user connections can be shared and transferred to the domain of user-item interactions, whereby to help learn user preferences.

arxiv-2108-01356.title: Maximum weighted likelihood estimator for robust heavy-tail modelling of finite mixture models
arxiv-2108-01356.creator: Tsz Chai Fung
arxiv-2108-01356.description: Abstract In this article, we present the maximum weighted likelihood estimator (MWLE) for robust estimations of heavy-tail finite mixture models (FMM). This is motivated by the complex distributional phenomena of insurance claim severity data, where flexible density estimation tools such as FMM are needed but MLE often produces unstable tail estimates under FMM.

arxiv-2111-03309.title: A survey on spectral conditions for some extremal graph problems Thanks: This is the second revised version in which we added some new references. This paper was published on Advances in Mathematics (China), 51 (2) (2022) 193–258; see the official website: http://www.oaj.pku.edu.cn/sxjz/CN/1000-0917
arxiv-2111-03309.creator: Yongtao Li, Weijun Liu, Lihua Feng
arxiv-2111-03309.description: Abstract This survey is two-fold. We first report new progress on the spectral extremal results on the Turán type problems in graph theory. More precisely, we shall summarize the spectral Turán function in terms of the adjacency spectral radius and the signless Laplacian spectral radius for various graphs.

arxiv-2303-01685.title: Multi-Scale Control Signal-Aware Transformer for Motion Synthesis without Phase
arxiv-2303-01685.creator: Lintao Wang, Kun Hu, Lei Bai, Yu Ding, Wanli Ouyang, Zhiyong Wang
arxiv-2303-01685.description: Abstract Synthesizing controllable motion for a character using deep learning has been a promising approach due to its potential to learn a compact model without laborious feature engineering. To produce dynamic motion from weak control signals such as desired paths, existing methods often require auxiliary information such as phases for alleviating motion ambiguity, which limits their generalisation capability.

arxiv-2401-04337.title: Exchange-correlation entropy from the generalized thermal adiabatic connection
arxiv-2401-04337.creator: Brittany P. Harding, Zachary Mauri, Vera Xie, Aurora Pribram-Jones
arxiv-2401-04337.description: Abstract Warm dense matter is a highly energetic phase characterized by strong correlations, thermal effects, and quantum mechanical electrons. Thermal density functional theory is commonly used in simulations of this challenging phase, driving the development of temperature-dependent approximations to the exchange-correlation free energy.

arxiv-2405-17669.title: Bayesian Nonparametrics for Principal Stratification with Continuous Post-Treatment Variables
arxiv-2405-17669.creator: Dafne Zorzetto
arxiv-2405-17669.description: Abstract Principal stratification provides a causal inference framework for investigating treatment effects in the presence of a post-treatment variable. Principal strata play a key role in characterizing the treatment effect by identifying groups of units with the same or similar values for the potential post-treatment variable at all treatment levels. The literature has focused mainly on binary post-treatment variables.

arxiv-2406-18128.title: Exploring external rarefied gas flows through the method of fundamental solutions
arxiv-2406-18128.creator: Himanshi, Anirudh Singh Rana, Vinay Kumar Gupta
arxiv-2406-18128.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Himanshi, Anirudh Singh Rana, Vinay Kumar Gupta. The well-known Navier–Stokes–Fourier equations of fluid dynamics are, in general, not adequate for describing rarefied gas flows. Moreover, while the Stokes equations—a simplified version of the Navier–Stokes–Fourier equations—are effective in modeling slow and steady liquid flow past a sphere, they fail to yield a non-trivial solution to the problem of slow and steady liquid flow past an infinitely long cylinder (a two-dimensional problem essentially); this is referred to as Stokes’ paradox.

arxiv-2412-01705.title: Uncertainty-Aware Regularization for Image-to-Image Translation
arxiv-2412-01705.creator: Anuja Vats, Ivar Farup, Marius Pedersen, Kiran Raja
arxiv-2412-01705.description: Abstract The importance of quantifying uncertainty in deep networks has become paramount for reliable real-world applications. In this paper, we propose a method to improve uncertainty estimation in medical Image-to-Image (I2I) translation. Our model integrates aleatoric uncertainty and employs Uncertainty-Aware Regularization (UAR) inspired by simple priors to refine uncertainty estimates and enhance reconstruction quality.

arxiv-2412-16154.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Melvyn B. Nathanson. Let A A be a finite set of integers and let h ​ A hA be its h h -fold sumset. This paper investigates the sequence of sumset sizes ( | h ​ A | ) h = 1 ∞ (|hA|)_{h=1}^{\infty} , the relations between these sequences for affinely inequivalent sets A A and B B , and the comparative growth rates and configurations of the sumset size sequences ( | h ​ A | ) h = 1 ∞ (|hA|)_{h=1}^{\infty}

arxiv-2506-01189.title: SVarM: Linear Support Varifold Machines for Classification and Regression on Geometric Data
arxiv-2506-01189.creator: Emmanuel Hartman, Nicolas Charon
arxiv-2506-01189.description: Abstract Despite progress in the rapidly developing field of geometric deep learning, performing statistical analysis on geometric data—where each observation is a shape such as a curve, graph, or surface—remains challenging due to the non-Euclidean nature of shape spaces, which are defined as equivalence classes under invariance groups.

arxiv-2509-07544.title: Totally real divisors on curves
arxiv-2509-07544.creator: Lorenzo Baldi * and Mario Kummer † \dagger and Daniel Plaumann ‡ \ddagger
arxiv-2509-07544.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lorenzo Baldi * and Mario Kummer † \dagger and Daniel Plaumann ‡ \ddagger. Since the works of Krasnov and Scheiderer, there has been an interest in studying effective totally real divisors on a curve X X defined over a real closed field, i.e., effective divisors supported on the real locus. Scheiderer proved that, for smooth curves over R \mathbb{R} with nonempty real locus, each divisor of sufficiently high degree is linearly equivalent to an effective totally real one.

britannica-1911-tyndale-william.title: Tyndale, William (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-tyndale-william.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-tyndale-william.description: Article 'Tyndale, William' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 27), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Oligocene genus Dichobune (see Artiodactyla). Homaeodon was an animal of the size of a rabbit, with five toes (of which only five were functional to each foot) and 44 teeth, of which the molars are tuberculated (bunodont), with six columns on those of the upper jaw; the premolars being of a cutting type.

pmc-10594859.title: Delayed vascular complication after collagenase injection for Dupuytren disease
pmc-10594859.creator: Jesper Nordenskjöld, Jonas Nilsson, Roua Kalaf, Isam Atroshi
pmc-10594859.description: BackgroundVascular adverse events after collagenase injection for Dupuytren disease are absent in large trials and systematic reviews. The aim of this study is to present a case series of delayed vascular complications after collagenase treatment.MethodsA prospective evaluation of 1181 consecutively treated patients at one orthopedic department identified three patients reporting symptoms of possible vascular complication.

pmc-10623805.title: Fatigue risk assessment of a Helicopter Emergency Medical Service crew working a 24/7 shift pattern: results of a prospective service evaluation
pmc-10623805.creator: C Rose, E ter Avest, R M Lyon
pmc-10623805.description: BackgroundThe work of Helicopter Emergency Medical Services (HEMS) teams crosses the boundaries of several high-risk occupations including medicine, aviation, and transport. Working conditions can be challenging and operational demands requires a 24-h rota, resulting in disruption of the normal circadian rhythm. HEMS crews are therefore prone to both mental and physical fatigue.

pmc-10682848.title: Missed opportunities in the diagnosis of heart failure: a real‐world assessment
pmc-10682848.creator: João Pedro Ferreira, Tiago Taveira‐Gomes, Mariana Canelas‐Pais, Phillip Phan, Filipa Bernardo, Karolina Andersson Sundell, Mário Almeida, Hugo Martinho, Cristina Gavina
pmc-10682848.description: AimsHeart failure (HF) is a leading cause of hospitalization worldwide. An early HF diagnosis is key to reducing hospitalizations. We used electronic health records (EHRs) to characterize HF pathways at the primary care physician (PCP) level prior to a first HF hospitalization (hHF).

pmc-11333756.title: Calculating the fatigue strength of load-bearing structures of special self-propelled rolling stock
pmc-11333756.creator: Ziyoda Mukhamedova, Sherzod Fayzibayev, Dilbar Mukhamedova, Aida M Batirbekova, Kamila Jurayeva, Gushan Ibragimova, Zakhro Ergasheva
pmc-11333756.description: This research primarily focuses on the strength indicators of the bearing structures of ADM-1 special self-propelled rolling stock. The special self-propelled rolling stock used by Uzbek railroads reaching the end of their functional life is a pertinent problem as Uzbekistan's railway system is growing rapidly, but there is a lack of enough funds to buy new special self-propelled rolling stock.

pmc-11367821.title: The association between long noncoding RNA ABHD11-AS1 and malignancy prognosis: a meta-analysis
pmc-11367821.creator: Guangyao Lin, Tao Ye, Jing Wang
pmc-11367821.description: BackgroundAccumulating evidence has highlighted that lncRNA ABHD11-AS1 plays an essential role in tumorigenesis and is expected to become a new predictive biomarker and ideal target for cancer therapy, whereas some of their findings are conflicting due to the relatively small sample size of individual studies. Thus, this meta-analysis aimed to quantitatively ascertain the association of ABHD11-AS1 with diverse human malignancies.

pmc-11405958.title: A Novel Presentation of Eclipsed Mitral Regurgitation
pmc-11405958.creator: Jonathan Knott, Charlie Luoma, Anna Pearce, Daniel Davies, Ratnasari Padang, Adelaide Arruda-Olson, Patricia A. Pellikka, Mackram F. Eleid, Jeremy Thaden
pmc-11405958.description: Eclipsed mitral regurgitation (MR) is a rare phenomenon of transient severe MR in patients with normal left ventricular function. This paper presents a case of a patient with recurrent heart failure exacerbations and transient, positional severe MR consistent with eclipsed MR, which improved after mitral transcatheter edge-to-edge repair.

pmc-11449486.title: An in vitro approach reveals molecular mechanisms underlying endocrine disruptor-induced epimutagenesis
pmc-11449486.creator: Jake D Lehle, Yu-Huey Lin, Amanda Gomez, Laura Chavez, John R McCarrey, Isabelle Mansuy, Jake D Lehle, Yu-Huey Lin, Amanda Gomez, Laura Chavez, John R McCarrey
pmc-11449486.description: Endocrine disrupting chemicals (EDCs) such as bisphenol S (BPS) are xenobiotic compounds that can disrupt endocrine signaling due to steric similarities to endogenous hormones. EDCs have been shown to induce disruptions in normal epigenetic programming (epimutations) and differentially expressed genes (DEGs) that predispose disease states. Most interestingly, the prevalence of epimutations following exposure to many EDCs persists over multiple generations.

pmc-11608003.title: Association of Vitamin B12 and Polymorphism of TCN2 with Early-Onset Post-Stroke Depression
pmc-11608003.creator: Jingyuan Zhang, Qiao Liao, Hengshu Chen, Fan Liu, Dongren Sun, Shihang Luo, Yeqing Xiao, Weiye Xu, Fafa Tian, Mingyu Song
pmc-11608003.description: BackgroundPost-stroke depression (PSD) is a common neuropsychiatric complication after a stroke with complex mechanisms. However, few studies have identified the role of vitamin B12 and folate in the occurrence and pathophysiology of PSD. The aim of our study is to investigate the relationship among vitamin B12, folate, their transporter genes, and early-onset PSD.

pmc-11644014.title: Association Between the EAT-Lancet Reference Diet and Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: A Mini-Review
pmc-11644014.creator: Niuniu Sun, Shubo Wen, Zhenyu Huo, Zitong He, Tongyao Sun, Jingxi Hu, Emily Sonestedt, Yan Borné, Shunming Zhang
pmc-11644014.description: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) is a prevalent pregnancy complication that seriously endangers maternal and infant health, posing a medical and economic burden worldwide. Several dietary patterns have been recommended for women of childbearing age, demonstrating a positive role in preventing and managing GDM.

pmc-12370880.title: Multi-scale and multi-context interpretable mapping of cell states across heterogeneous spatial samples
pmc-12370880.creator: Patrick C. N. Martin, Wenqi Wang, Hyobin Kim, Henrietta Holze, Paul B. Fisher, Arturo P. Saavedra, Robert A. Winn, Esha Madan, Rajan Gogna, Kyoung Jae Won
pmc-12370880.description: There is a growing demand for methods that can effectively align and compare spatial data in the absence of obvious visual correspondence. To address this challenge, we developed an interpretable cell mapping strategy based on solving a Linear Assignment Problem (LAP) where the total cost is computed by considering cells and their niches.

pmc-12673851.title: Reciprocal escalation of violent extremism: Experimental and longitudinal evidence from Denmark
pmc-12673851.creator: Milan Obaidi, Robin Bergh, John F Dovidio
pmc-12673851.description: Recent surges in intergroup conflict across racial, religious, and national lines highlight how mutual perceptions of threat can lead to escalating cycles of hostility. These cycles are believed to be driven by interconnected psychological, sociopolitical, and cultural mechanisms, with each group responding aggressively to perceived hostility from the other.

pmc-13106576.title: Editorial: Exploring the role of exercise in hypertension and blood pressure variability
pmc-13106576.creator: Giuseppe Caminiti, Marco Alfonso Perrone
pmc-13106576.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). of BP over time, has also emerged as an independent predictor of cardiovascular events (2). The management of AH and BPV requires a multifaceted approach, encompassing both long-term pharmacological therapy and the adoption of healthy lifestyle habits. Among lifestyle strategies, exercise training (ET) is widely recognized as an effective intervention for preventing increases in BP and reducing BP levels in individuals with established AH. Nevertheless, several aspects of exercise prescription for BP control remain insufficiently defined.

pmc-13173378.title: Home Health Value-Based Purchasing and Postacute Home Health Visits Among Older Adults With Dementia
pmc-13173378.creator: Ming-Ting Yang, Aaron Bloschichak, Qiuyuan Qin, Helena Temkin-Greener, Shubing Cai
pmc-13173378.description: This cohort study examines the association between Home Health Value-Based Purchasing programs and volume of nursing and therapy services after hospital discharge among Medicare beneficiaries with Alzheimer disease and related dementias. Introduction Medicare home health is a key postacute care option providing homebound beneficiaries with skilled nursing and therapy services.

pmc-13412589.title: Comparison of Midazolam Plasma Concentrations in ARDS Patients with and Without ECMO Support—Prospective Observational Pilot Study
pmc-13412589.creator: Marek Grochla, Marcin Basiak, Bogusław Okopień, Ewa Trejnowska, Piotr Knapik
pmc-13412589.description: Introduction: Patients undergoing ECMO therapy have a much higher need for drug therapy due to the increased volume of distribution and deeper levels of sedation. The influence of ECMO support on the achieved midazolam concentrations is unknown. Materials and Methods: This prospective, single-center study was conducted between October 2022 and December 2024.
